scope: Manual conversion UI in an isolated native AppKit QA app with public sample inputs; final installed-package verification is separate.

backend_quality_tests.scope: Actual encodes for five image, six audio and sixteen video target profiles; low-rate mono audio, short clips, CLI validation, concurrent profiles, unchanged defaults and skip-same precedence.

controls.audio_estimate: Known duration × target bitrate; approximate encoded audio bytes, actual size varies.
controls.image_video_estimate: No numeric promise; output size depends on content.

limits: No claim of perceived quality for every input or codec.
Folder rules keep existing encoder defaults.
A quality setting of 100 can still be lossy.
Audio estimates do not guarantee total output size.
Final whole-app visual grade remains pending unlocked-Mac review.
